children: SciBase received a binding SEK 24.2M guarantee from Bergs Securities, bringing subscription undertakings and guarantees to SEK 57.5M, covering 100% of its ongoing rights issue.
Removes execution risk of the raise; liquidity runway improves if proceeds are received.
Backstop ensures unsubscribed shares will be taken up, supporting completion.
Existing holders’ support reduces dilution uncertainty and signals confidence.
Risk dispersed across a consortium, lowering single-party default risk.
Some residual counterparty risk remains until funds are settled.

This confirms full coverage of a previously announced capital raise, reducing near-term financing risk. A stronger catalyst would be successful subscription settlement and guidance on use of proceeds translating into revenue or margin gains.
